task.title: Implement JWT Authentication Middleware and Route Protection
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware validates JWT token from Authorization Bearer header
Missing or invalid tokens respond with HTTP 401 Unauthorized formatted using shared/payload.Response and pkg/localerror
Product, user, and category routes in cmd/api/api.go are protected with the JWT middleware
Unit tests in internal/adapter/controller/auth_middleware_test.go verify authorized access and 401 unauthorized rejections
Hanya file dalam `allowed_paths` yang berubah akibat task ini.

agentResult.response:
Implementasi JWT Authentication Middleware dan proteksi route API untuk product, user, dan category telah selesai dikerjakan sesuai kontrak arsitektur dan acceptance criteria.

### File Berubah
1. [`internal/adapter/controller/auth_middleware.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-010-20260827t045120z-fdbc000d/internal/adapter/controller/auth_middleware.go)
   - Mengimplementasikan `NewJWTAuthMiddleware` untuk validasi token JWT dari header `Authorization: [REDACTED] <token>`.
   - Mengembalikan HTTP 401 Unauthorized berformat `payload.ErrorResponse` dan `localerror.AccessControlError` untuk token yang tidak ada, format header tidak valid, atau token invalid/kedaluwarsa.
   - Mengimplementasikan `ProtectedRouter` (`api.Router`), `NewProtectedRouter`, `NewProtectedRouterWithMiddleware`, `ProtectRoute`, dan helper `NewTokenServiceFromPort`.
2. [`internal/adapter/controller/auth_middleware_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-010-20260827t045120z-fdbc000d/internal/adapter/controller/auth_middleware_test.go)
   - Unit test menyeluruh untuk validasi authorized access (200 OK / 201 Created) dan penolakan 401 Unauthorized (missing header, invalid prefix, empty bearer, expired/invalid token), 500 internal server error untuk unconfigured token service, serta verifikasi proteksi route pada [`ProductController`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-010-20260827t045120z-fdbc000d/internal/adapter/controller/product.go#L17-L31), [`CategoryController`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-010-20260827t045120z-fdbc000d/internal/adapter/controller/category.go#L17-L31), dan [`UserController`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-010-20260827t045120z-fdbc000d/internal/adapter/controller/user.go#L17-L44).
3. [`cmd/api/api.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-010-20260827t045120z-fdbc000d/cmd/api/api.go)
   - Membungkus registrasi controller user, category, dan product dengan `controller.NewProtectedRouter` menggunakan `TokenService` dari `controller.NewTokenServiceFromPort(port)`.

### Rekomendasi Verifikasi
- `go test ./...`
- `go vet ./...`

proposal.title: Implement JWT Authentication Middleware and Route Protection
proposal.summary: Implementasi JWT Authentication Middleware (NewJWTAuthMiddleware) dan wrapper ProtectedRouter untuk proteksi rute API user, category, dan product dengan respons standar HTTP 401 Unauthorized pada be-golang-app.
proposal.rationale: Implementasi middleware autentikasi JWT dan pembungkusan ProtectedRouter pada endpoint user, category, dan product merupakan implementasi fitur spesifik proyek be-golang-app yang mematuhi arsitektur eksisting tanpa memperkenalkan pattern baru lintas proyek.
considerations: Implementasi ProtectedRouter dan NewJWTAuthMiddleware mengikuti standar Modular Clean Architecture spesifik repositori be-golang-app

Pola global route protection dan JWT context enrichment sudah terdokumentasi di 01-Knowledge/patterns/backend/declarative-route-registration-context-enriching-guard-pipeline.md dan 01-Knowledge/concepts/modular-router-registration-contextual-session-propagation.md
